children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may test support at $6.88 per bushel, a break below which could open the way towards $6.78-1/2.
A projection analysis on the fall from $7.43-1/4 reveals a series of projection levels that have been closely controlling the downtrend.

The contract has broken the support at $6.93-3/4, the 123.6% level. The next support will be at $6.88. A break above $6.93-3/4, now a resistance, may lead to a gain into the $6.97-1/2 to $7.03-1/4 range.
